title: Miltenyi MACS Bead Isolation
author: Dannielle DK Moore
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yfzftp6
materials: MACS isolation labelling reagents in Miltenyi Cell isolation Kit Miltenyi Biotec added according to the manufacturers instruction (volume and incubation time). During this step, samples are incubated at 4 °C

steps.title: Wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Wash isolated PBMCs in 10 mL 1x MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) by centrifuging at 400xg for 10 minutes at 23 °C (Room Temp).

steps.title: Resuspend PBMCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend PBMCs in 1x MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) using the recommended volume per 1x10^7 cells according to kit specifications.

steps.title: Post-Incubation Wash
steps.instruction: Following incubation, add 1 mL 1x MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) to the cell suspension and centrifuge at 300xg for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare MACS Separator
steps.instruction: Set up the MACS MultiStand (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-042-303) in the hood and prepare the LS Columns (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-042-401).

substeps.instruction: Place LS Columns in the MACS separator.
Prime columns with 3x 1 mL MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221).

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspension for Column
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 500 µL 1x MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) up to a total cell count of 1x10^8.

steps.title: Apply Cells to LS Column
steps.instruction: Apply the cell suspension to the primed LS Columns (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-042-401).

substeps.instruction: Rinse the tube used for cell storage 3x with 1 mL MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) and add this suspension to the LS column as Wash 1.

steps.title: Wash LS Column
steps.instruction: Top up the LS Column twice with 3 mL MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) for Wash 2 and Wash 3.

steps.title: Collect Isolated Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the isolated cell population based on the selection process.

substeps.instruction: For negative selection: Collect the flow-through.
For positive selection: Plunge the LS Column with 3 mL MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221) into a separate tube.

steps.title: Concentrate Isolated Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension containing the cell population of interest at 350xg for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend Isolated Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend isolated cells in 500 µL to 2 mL (depending on cell type) of MACS Separation Buffer (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-091-221).

steps.title: Cell Counting and Viability Check
steps.instruction: Dilute cells in a 1:10 ratio with 1x Phosphate-Buffered Saline (Lonza Catalog #04-479Q) and 0.4% Sterile-filtered Trypan Blue Solution (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #T8154).

substeps.instruction: Count cells using a haemocytometer and microscope.
Record observed cell number and cell viability.

steps.title: Sample Purity Check
steps.instruction: Aliquot 10 µL of the cell suspension for a sample purity check.
